description: Fit physical μ/y-like spectral distortion templates to public COBE/FIRAS monopole spectrum.

falsification_logic.confirm_like: a physically normalized staged distortion amplitude is nonzero and below FIRAS limits
falsification_logic.falsify_like: predicted staged amplitude is above FIRAS residual limits

metrics.note: Physical-template screen with nuisance blackbody/calibration terms; v9.5 adds unit audit, but this is still not the official FIRAS covariance likelihood.

unit_audit.warning: FIRAS public monopole tables have legacy units; official covariance/residual likelihood is still required for a hard P28 bound.
